_about: Machine-readable part of an experiment: the ```json card block in section 0 of experiments/E<id>_<slug>/experiment.md (templates/experiment.md); an older experiment.json is still read. Checked by autoresearch/tools/experiment.py check; decided by autoresearch/tools/decide.py --experiment. Plain JSON, no JSON-Schema library: 'required' lists the fields that must exist, 'types' their python types, 'enum' the allowed values, 'fields' the meaning.

fields.card: the hypothesis card it tests (H<cycle>.<n>) or empty
fields.title: short title
fields.kind: variant = a config change only (experiment file -> run -> decide -> one summary line); block = new code (detail plan -> code + review -> run)
fields.metric: the headline metric the verdict is about (e.g. Q); its band is 'band'
fields.direction: higher | lower: which way is better for the headline metric
fields.band: noise band of the headline metric (S / Q: 0.010); inside it the arms tie
fields.prediction: {value: number, vs: <arm letter>}: the predicted headline effect (variant minus vs), written before the run
fields.arms: {<letter>: {names: [registry names, one per seed] | cards: [card refs, one per seed] | {subset: card ref | [card refs]}, run_ids: [...], recipe | command, base, set, seeds, note}}; a card ref is a path relative to the problem folder, optionally '#a/b/c' into the JSON (a card has its metrics under 'metrics', a flat dict is taken as the metrics)
fields.control: the arm letter of the matched reference (equal budget, same frames)
fields.variant: the arm letter that is judged (default: the first arm that is not the control)
fields.rule: list of clauses, ALL must hold for KEEP: {metric, vs?: <arm letter, default control>, min_effect?: number >= 0 (variant - vs >= this), max_loss?: number >= 0 (variant - vs >= -this), band?: number, subsets?: [unique subset names], at_least?: int from 1 to the number of subsets (1 without subsets): how many subsets must pass, note?}. A card file listed twice (in one arm or in two arms) is refused
fields.sources: optional list of '<topic slug>/<note id>': the research notes (<problem>/<research folder>/topics/<slug>/<note id>/note.md) this experiment tests; decide.py --write sets their `result` line to '<id>: <VERDICT> effect <+0.0000>' (topic_table.py) and makes the topic table again
fields.budget_gpu_h: planned GPU hours; `experiment.py show` compares it with the duration of the ledger rows E<n> and E<n>.*
fields.kill: stop early when ...: Training kill rules (`key@step > value [window N]`), one per line or separated by `;`; `experiment.py kill E<n> --run <run folder> --write` appends them to the run's kill.txt (prose is refused), `Training watch --enforce` stops a run that hits one
fields.evaluate: {split: val | test | confirm, subset?: val250, compare: <control arm letter>, allow?: [split | subset | denominator | protocol | provenance]}: how the cards are made (evaluate.py <name> --compare <control name>). decide.py refuses arms whose cards differ in split (must be this split), subset, denominator (frames / n) or protocol, and, for cards with a provenance block, in GT version, GT signature, evaluator code hash, frame hash or raw-data manifest hash, or whose evaluator differs from its commit or was not checked; allow names a difference you know and accept (the decision records what was waived)
fields.seeds: the seeds every arm runs, one list: as long as the cards of the arms it declares that every arm lists its cards in this order, so the cards are paired by position. A card's own `seed` or an arm's own `seeds` list (as long as the arm's whole-split cards) is an identity instead: the arms are then paired by seed whatever the order of their lists
fields.pairing: 'position' = the cards of two arms are paired by their order in the lists (card i against card i), also when the cards carry seeds (two models of one seed per arm); without a seed identity, a `seeds` list of the experiment or this declaration decide.py refuses to pair two or more seeds
fields.deterministic: true when the arms share the checkpoint and differ by a deterministic step (assembly, pruning, threshold): no training seed exists, the paired scene-bootstrap interval decides

verdicts.KEEP: headline effect beyond the band in the better direction, every paired seed on the same side, the paired-bootstrap interval (when a compare card exists) excludes 0, and every clause holds
verdicts.CUT: headline effect beyond the band in the worse direction, or a max_loss guard violated, or a min_effect clause missed with agreeing seeds
verdicts.TIE: headline effect inside the band and no guard violated: take the cheaper arm
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: beyond the band but one seed only, seeds disagree, or the interval contains 0: add a seed, do not adopt
